title: Joke of the Day
description: A fun little data pack that tells you a random joke every Minecraft day!
body:
Joke of the Day is a simple but fun(ny) datapack that tells you a random joke every Minecraft day!

Whenever the day counter resets (day time 0), a random joke is sent in chat. Some are terrible, some are cheesy, and some are completely random, but hopefully at least a few of them will make you smile. :)

Most of the jokes were suggested by the community, so if you have a joke you'd like to see in the pack, feel free to suggest it [here](https://www.planetminecraft.com/forums/minecraft/datapacks/i-need-your-best-terrible-jokes-for-a-data-pack-i-m-making-706998/) on Planet Minecraft! (If your joke is added it may take some time for the pack to be updated since there will need to be at least a few new jokes in each update)


![Joke preview: Every machine in the coin factory broke down all of a sudden without explanation. It just doesn't make any cents.](https://i.postimg.cc/pTd8Wd8N/Screenshot-2026-05-30-095753.png)


Plus, this pack is fully multiplayer-compatible so feel free to install it on your server!

I hope you enjoy the pack and that it makes your Minecraft world just a little bit funnier!
